segments.an5.1:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.an5.1:2.3: Saddhābalaṃ, hirībalaṃ [hiribalaṃ (sī. pī.)], ottappabalaṃ, vīriyabalaṃ [viriyabalaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)], paññābalaṃ – imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca sekhabalāni.
segments.an5.1:3.2: ‘saddhābalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalena, hirībalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalena, ottappabalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalena, vīriyabalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalena, paññābalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalenā’ti.
segments.an5.1:3.5: Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.

lines: Tasmāti yasmā imāni sattannaṃ sekhānaṃ balāni, tasmā.
